notes.title: Update 7/10/22
notes.content:
-More in-depth tutorial
-Fixed collisions
-Camera can now be moved/rotated
-Fixed minor bugs

notes.title: Update 7/1/22
notes.content:
Hey guys! We're always looking for ways to make Nova Slash the best action game out there! We fixed a problem where the new soldier enemy didn't take damage when they were idling. There will be an even bigger update in the coming weeks... Let us know what you think of the game here or on the discord!

Icuzo
